title: Sprint Weave deploy brief and afterglow notes
content:
Purpose:
A compact ops brief for the Sprint Weave release (feature bundle v2026.03.1). Contains the preflight checklist, a concise 48h rollout calendar, immediate rollback/mitigation steps, and a first-draft of release notes + afterglow actions. This is the working doc for on-call and deploy crew; expect edits during the dry run.

Scope / What this deploy contains:
- Model routing changes: introduce weighted traffic split 90/10 to new routing policy (routing-v2).
- Serving runtime: small config tweak to token batching heuristic (batch-limit: 64 -> 48).
- Console: per-route telemetry tags for latency breakdown (ui flags only).
- Infra: kernel selection fallback enabled for a subset of instances (a/b).

Known risks / open questions (notes-to-self):
- Unclear interaction of smaller batch-limit with long-sequence clients (ENG-1428: follow-up needed).
- Telemetry tag propagation may double-count tokens in the first 15 minutes (monitoring query ready).
- Need signoff from privacy for the route-tag change; pinged Tanya.

Go / No-Go preflight checklist (prior to T-1h):
[ ] All cascade PRs merged and green (runtime/#678, route-config/#201)
[ ] Canary manifests applied in staging and smoke tests passed (smoke id: smoke-20260310-1)
[ ] Observability runbook updated with new metric names (latency.route.v2, batch.size.effective)
[ ] Incident channel created: #deploy-sprint-weave (creds posted to rotation doc)
[ ] Pager rotation for 48h staffed and acknowledged (owners: Priya, Jordan, Mateo)
[ ] Rollout playbook and rollback artifacts uploaded to conf:release/sprint-weave-2026-03

T-minus 60 to T-plus 0: hour-by-hour runway (compact)
Day 0 (Launch day):
- T-60 -> T-30: Final smoke in staging (synth traffic), confirm no memory regressions.
- T-30 -> T-10: Apply route-weight override to 1% on a single region, monitor for 10m.
- T-10 -> T-0: Increase region to 5% if no signals; briefing call at T-5.
- T0: Global split 90/10 (old/new) rollout start. Start 15m watch window.

T-plus immediate windows:
- 0-15m: watch latency P50/P95, error-rate, queue-depth, and batch-size effective.
- 15-45m: if stable, increase to 25% new; run short A/B quality checks on prompt-suite (psuite-quick-1).
- 45-90m: if stable, increase to 50% new and start broader traffic.
- 90-180m: final ramp to 90/10 over region-aware increments; leave 10% on old for fallback.

Rollback triggers (if any true -> immediate rollback to old routing):
- sustained P95 latency increase > 220ms above baseline for 5m across >=2 regions
- error-rate increase > 0.5% absolute and >2x baseline
- telemetry tag mismatch causing missing billing attribution (>0.2% of requests)
- memory OOMs or serve process restarts > 3 in any 10m window

Immediate rollback procedure (fast path):
1) Execute route weight toggle script: /ops/bin/route-weight --set new=0 --env prod --iam-delegate
2) Revert runtime config via canary manifest rollback (k8s rollout undo runtime-deploy --to-revision=<prev>)
3) Notify #deploy-sprint-weave with incident template and assign SRE lead
4) If rollback doesn't stabilize within 10m: fail over affected regions to Dedicated pool (runbook link)

Monitoring queries to run (quick list):
- latency baseline comparison: SELECT p95 FROM latency WHERE route IN ("main") GROUP BY region, 1m
- error delta: SELECT count_if(status>=500) / count(*) FROM requests WHERE timeframe=1m
- batch histogram: SELECT histogram(batch_size) FROM requests WHERE route IN ("main")

Release notes (first draft - public-facing):
Title: Sprint Weave (v2026.03.1) — routing, batching, and telemetry updates
What’s new:
- New routing policy (routing-v2) rolled out with gradual traffic weighting. This allows safer model variant rollouts and faster failovers.
- Serving runtime batching heuristic updated to improve tail latency for short-request clients.
- Console telemetry now includes route-level latency breakdowns (per-route P50/P95) for easier troubleshooting.
Why this matters:
- Faster failover and safer model experimentation for product teams; small latency wins for typical short-turnaround queries.

User impact (external):
- Expect no downtime. Small percentage of traffic will be routed to new handling; negligible functional changes.
- We recommend customers pin mission-critical routes to Dedicated until they validate their internal telemetry.

Internal notes for release docs team:
- Expand the short A/B quality results into a public paragraph once psuite-quick-1 passes. Attach sample prompts + before/after latencies.
- Ensure billing/usage attribution tests are included in the billing test matrix.

Afterglow / 48h post-release checklist (working):
[ ] 0-3h: stabilize and re-check telemetry tag counts; reconcile billing logs.
[ ] 3-12h: confirm no regression on long-sequence clients; run full psuite run (psuite-full-2026-03)
[ ] 12-24h: perform sampling QA of generated outputs for quality drift across model variants (assign SEs)
[ ] 24-48h: finalize release notes with observed metrics and push to docs site; debrief session scheduled.

Debrief items / Retro seeds (to capture during afterglow):
- Did the smaller batch-limit reduce tail latency as expected? (collect p95 delta per client class)
- Were telemetry tags correctly propagated across internal proxies? (root cause for mismatch if seen)
- Which step in the runway felt fragile (manual toggles, unclear owner, long approval wait)?

Appendix: quick links + run commands (ops shorthand)
- route toggle: ops-run route-toggle --policy routing-v2 --set 10% --region us-west-2
- rollback: ops-run route-toggle --policy routing-v2 --set 0% --region all
- smoke test script: /ci/smoke/sprint-weave-smoke.sh --short
- monitoring dashboard: dashboards/ops/sprint-weave-2026-03

Notes to reviewer:
This is an intentionally compact, deploy-centric doc for the crew on the day of deploy. Please add any missing run commands, clarify owner for each watch window, and flag any outstanding privacy signoffs. I'll iterate this during the dry-run tomorrow morning.

--- END OF BRIEF (working draft)
